description: This file defines the HomeActivity class which manages the main tabbed navigation UI for an Android application. It sets up tabs for chats, groups, status, and settings, and loads corresponding fragments into each tab on creation.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Root activity with tabbed navigation containing fragments for chats, groups, status, and settings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up tabbed navigation, and loads the respective fragments into each tab.
